button.behavior: submit stays visible; loading blocks duplicate activation; keep label; no disabling solely to hide validation

input.error: border2 danger; aria-invalid; describedby; first error focus; keep valid data

quantity.behavior: step=1 for piece quantities; minimum1; removing row requires explicit action

card.size: padding16; radius16; border1 line; no nested cards

status.behavior: semantic text always present; delivery and payment independent; use status-map.json

chip-select.size: min-height48 when interactive; display badge28 only noninteractive

segments.behavior: mutually exclusive scenarios; aria-pressed; arrows optional; no automatic price mutation

bottom-nav.behavior: aria-current=page; active label+background; never icon alone

sheet-dialog.size: width min(480,100%); max-height85dvh; padding20; radius24; scrim #38291F66
sheet-dialog.behavior: native dialog/headless equivalent; trap focus; restore trigger; Escape close only non-destructive; dirty close opens discard confirmation

toast.size: max-width430; viewport gap16; padding14 16; radius12; bottom88+safeArea
toast.behavior: polite status; 6 seconds; no essential information solely transient; errors persistent

empty.behavior: explain why and one relevant next action; never use dash as zero

loading.behavior: aria-busy region; status text; skeleton aria-hidden; static under reduced motion

error-global.behavior: keep form; retry with idempotency; never claim saved before server

money.behavior: MXN explicit; 2dp amounts; 4+dp normalized cost; unknown dash plus cause; never silently zero

image.behavior: cover position65% 50%; missing uses image icon+Sin foto; optional; no decorative photo in money errors
